title: The pool report marks an Opus cell that ran only the sanity subset, read from its planned_kinds row
goal: bench_report.py marks in the pool tables each cell of an arm label whose planned_kinds row names fewer kinds than the pool (the opus-5-5 sanity subset of ST-7tl6pbqf), for example with its row count, so a future subset record is told apart from a full one without the prose note; and the --kinds help text of benchmarks.py no longer says default all where --kinds all is refused as an unknown kind (found by the SP-x7ger6vu review: ST-7tl6pbqf's table-marking clause was met by a prose note, as bench_report.py was outside its touches)
